evidence_quotes.O: Brainwavz M2 In-Ear Headphones have given me a new appreciation for my music. I have a huge collection of songs, both old and new, on iTunes.
evidence_quotes.C: I've checked the photos this produces over with a magnifying glass, and they are extremely sharp and crisp, with great color.
evidence_quotes.E: I put this to the test for hours last night on Skype. No longer did people say that at times they couldn't hear me, or understand what I was saying.
evidence_quotes.A: I'm not sure if the Pavilion is a separate division of HP or not, but it's a name I know and trust.
evidence_quotes.N: at first I was so annoyed with the thickness and weight I considered knocking off a star for this.
